user.title: EV charging and billing

data.name: Installation name
data.seller: Seller name, address and tax details
data.power_sensor: Dedicated EV power sensor (W or kW)
data.smtp_password: SMTP password (for Gmail, use a Google app password)
data.max_age: Maximum power reading age in seconds

user.description: Configure one customer and dedicated EV power sensor. Enter SMTP settings directly; no email entity is needed. Gmail selects smtp.gmail.com:587 with STARTTLS automatically: enter your Gmail address as username and use a Google app password, not your normal password. Leave sender blank to use the Gmail username. Custom server fields are ignored for Gmail. Switch control and automatic email are optional.

error.invalid_config: Check the W/kW sensor, unique sensor/switch assignment, SMTP server/sender/customer email when automatic email is enabled, three-letter currency, nonnegative rates, tax (0–100), and whole-minute schedule times. Currency cannot change on an existing account.
